purpose: Audit the variational gradient/quartic constraints before treating tensor-sector numbers as a mixed-row decision.

model.reduced_potential: f4 = sum_{i<j} c_ij |xi_i|^2 |xi_j|^2 + Re(q_ij xi_i^2 conjugate(xi_j)^2) plus self/global terms
model.gradient_equation: partial f4 / partial conjugate(xi_j) = P_j xi_j + Q_j conjugate(xi_j) (up to convention factors)
checks: c_ij must be real and symmetric in a true gradient reduction
q_ji must be conjugate(q_ij) after common frame transport
Euler: homogeneous f4 of degree 4 has gradient zero only at value f4=0
phase variables are real gluing parameters; equal-phase collapse to |q_diag| vs |2q_adj+q_diag| is an extra ansatz, not the general decision

diagonal_AB.warning: AB one-form sector only; not the full reduced gradient.

AB_channel.interpretation: AB is a P/trace channel only in the inspected odd sector. The nonzero compatible-row partial P cannot be the final LS gradient on the KE locus; missing tensor-even, self/frame, complement and global terms must cancel or change coordinates.

old_scalar_decomposition.meaning: This reproduces the older scalar adjacent value as P+one angular Q evaluation at a fixed source/receiver angle; it is not a pure P coefficient.

warnings: This is only the chirality-odd/odd tensor sector, justified by the corrected physical Sym^2(K) odd source identity; it does not include even sources or individual plus/minus residual components.

Only value-of-T times Hessian-of-scalar pieces are needed for the odd receiver/source identity. The full even source would require the complete second jet of tensor harmonics and is not computed here.
The output should be interpreted on physical sources M=t^2uu^T and receiver components u^T A u, u_perp^T A u; a kernel in unconstrained Sym^2(K) need not represent a physical insertion.

phase_reachability_two_adjacent_terms.interpretation: The two adjacent Q terms in the diagonal balanced NN equation should be treated as independently phase-tunable (one holomorphic, one anti-holomorphic after pole signs), not collapsed to a fixed 2*q_adj unless an additional symmetric equal-phase ansatz is imposed.

compatible_KE_zero_test_status.source_grounding: OSS/Mabuchi-Mukai/Tian-Yau imply smooth degree-4 del Pezzo surfaces and the four-A1 boundary are KE in the compactified moduli; this supports a Kähler-compatible zero set of the full reduced Einstein gradient near the product quotient.
compatible_KE_zero_test_status.what_is_checked_here: Only partial raw Green sectors are checked, not the full variational LS potential in Kähler smoothing coordinates.
compatible_KE_zero_test_status.conclusion: The available partial coefficients do NOT pass a full compatible-locus zero test by themselves. This is expected because the computation omits sectors and coordinate/complement/global corrections. Therefore these partial coefficients must not be used alone to decide the mixed branch.

next_computational_implication: Assemble the finite-dimensional response as the gradient of one real quartic potential before interpreting signs.

Compute/organize the full compatible-pattern quartic (including AB, AA/BB even pieces, self/opposite-corner finite parts, frame/projector motion and global deformation variables) and require that its restriction to the KE-compatible Kähler smoothing locus has zero gradient/value.

Only after that calibration should mixed-pattern phase equations be solved; the generic decision is existence of a zero critical point of f4 on scale/phase/deformation directions, not |q_diag| versus |2q_adj+q_diag| at equal phase.
